source_catalog.use: Source field definitions and source-field choice codes only; no answer data

method.comparison_normalization: Unicode NFKC, case folding, alphanumeric label matching; raw PDF hashes retained
method.choice_family_definition: One printed source field is one family. A checkbox group counts once regardless of options. Each matrix row counts once. Completion status counts once. SourceField consolidates expanded checkbox export columns.
method.visible_family_method: Match complete printed labels to catalog source fields; bound repeated personal/family and CSF stage labels by their explicit section. Missing printed questions are absent, not blank answers.
method.identity_method: Group by exact printed Record ID. Compare separately parsed first name, last name, DOB, and MRN as strings with Unicode/case/outer-space normalization. Preserve MRN leading zeros. Raw demographics omitted from this artifact.

selection_patterns.radio: The PDF draws empty circles as vectors. Selected circles include Unicode ● text. For inline choices, associate that mark with the adjacent label in the same control row. For matrices, the mark column x-coordinate carries the value; flattened text order does not.
selection_patterns.checkbox: The PDF draws empty squares as vectors. Selected squares contain ✓, ✔, ✗, or literal X text. These are alternative selected-mark styles; a cross is not a false/No answer. The two-column checkbox labels wrap, so row-only matching is insufficient.
selection_patterns.numeric_and_text: Synthetic handwritten-looking entries are native PDF text, including numeric values. Read text from the associated printed field region; do not interpret selection marks as numbers or use glyph shape guessing.
selection_patterns.blank: Visible unmarked periods matrix rows occur in doc_21.pdf and doc_24.pdf. Keep them blank. Do not convert unseen or missing checkbox fields to zero. A zero needs a visible verified empty checkbox option within a fully observed group.
selection_patterns.overflow: Conditional content and wrapped entries move boundaries between pages. doc_24.pdf page 4 contains only the footer. Page number alone is not instrument or field identity.
selection_patterns.unicode: NFKC resolves source ligatures such as ﬁ and ﬂ in labels and DSM footer. Keep an explicit canonical instrument allowlist after normalization.
selection_patterns.metadata_absent: No AcroForm/Widget data is present; no explicit repeat instance or data access group is printed.

hit6.note: Visually rendered as a six-row matrix even though catalog validates each field as dropdown.

patient_influence.note: intercourse_v2 has the printed physical-activity question. Preserve catalog field identity rather than deriving meaning from field name.

extraction_design_alternatives.name: Instrument-aware text anchors with local geometry
extraction_design_alternatives.size: Smallest change if pipeline already retains PDF text tokens and bounding boxes
method: Normalize and validate the exact header/footer instrument. Extract Record ID and compare the explicit demographics before grouping.

Find catalog question and option labels as geometric anchors. Bound the answer region by the next question/section; use the same control row plus nearest option geometry for inline radio/checkbox controls.
For a matrix, find the printed column headers and row labels on that page, then assign one ● to the unique intersecting row and column. Use that exact instrument field mapping.
Read native text only within scalar answer regions. Retain file/page/bounding-box/label/mark provenance. Reject multiple marks, unmatched controls, or conflicting IDs.
extraction_design_alternatives.tradeoff: Small implementation; depends on robust label matching and section boundaries across page breaks. No hardcoded document IDs, selected answers, or answer-key lookup.

extraction_design_alternatives.name: Vector-control census with text label association
extraction_design_alternatives.size: Small independent parser for the recurring form geometry
method: Parse PDF rectangles and circle paths with the current transformation matrix to enumerate empty controls independently of selected text. Associate each shape with a nearby printed option or matrix row/column.
Find ✓, ✔, ✗, X, or ● text overlapping the corresponding shape. A visible empty square may establish zero only when the complete checkbox family is recovered and no ambiguity remains.
Use header/footer and explicit section anchors to attach controls to source fields. Read scalar native text from the associated line/box region.
Require one selected radio per resolved family or retain blank. Keep unresolved geometry or scalar text blank with review evidence.
extraction_design_alternatives.tradeoff: More geometry code; directly distinguishes selected, visible empty, and absent controls. Better support for wrapping and two-column groups without guessing mark shapes.

limitations: This is a training-only source census, independent of all keys and the test split. It does not measure extraction accuracy.
Counts refer to visible printed choice families, including unmarked rows; reference catalog counts include conditionally absent fields.
Source-field metadata contains known clipped/unreadable option wording. No missing label or numeric value was invented.
Only the four cited representative train pages were rendered for visual checks; all 45 pages were inspected through native text and PDF structure.
